description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldSingleEnum class, which extends SugarWidgetFieldEnum. It provides a method displayInput that generates an HTML select element with options, based on the provided layout definition and application list strings. It is part of the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM widget system for rendering single-enum fields in the user interface.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldSingleEnum
classes.description: A class extending the SugarWidgetFieldEnum class, responsible for rendering a select HTML element for single-enum fields.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Generates and returns an HTML select element for a single-enum field, using options from application list strings and layout definitions, optionally removing blank options.
